title: Questionable groups targeting women via UFO call-down events

tellings.quote: sense as a cover. Based on people I know and their interactions with some questionable groups out there, it seems like they're more interested in females.

plain: Some UFO events where people gather to try to call down a craft may be used as a cover by groups who are really after women. That is what Matthew Brown, a man presented on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels. He says he bases it on people he knows and their dealings with "some questionable groups out there", and that "it seems like they're more interested in females."
